title: In 1935, a Wall of Black Dust 500 Feet Tall Swallowed the Plains

scenes.text: In 1935, a wall of black dust rolled across America, taller than a skyscraper.
It was Palm Sunday, April 14th, and the afternoon started clear and calm.
Then a cold front pushed in, and a cloud five hundred feet tall hit the plains.
It got so dark people said they couldn't see their hand in front of their face.
Birds slammed into cars like hailstones.
About three hundred thousand tons of soil blew away in a single day. They call it Black Sunday.

description:
On April 14, 1935, a wall of black dust five hundred feet tall rolled across the American plains.
About three hundred thousand tons of soil blew away that day, a disaster later called Black Sunday.
What would you do if you saw this coming? Comment below.
first_comment: Black Sunday hit on a calm, clear afternoon. Do you know anyone whose family lived through the Dust Bowl?
